nodes.name: Execution Layer Benchmark.md
nodes.summary: Dev graph benchmark_result node (BENCH-004) recording execution-layer determinism and idempotency evidence: byte-identical sequence replay, fill distribution, guard-block attribution, and pinned portfolio-state hash, serving as the closing artifact for ADR-011 §7 gate (d).
nodes.languageNotes: Ontology type is benchmark_result (BENCH-004); measures replay_determinism, idempotency, fill_distribution, portfolio_state_hash, and guard_block_attribution.

nodes.name: Gold Decision Distribution Benchmark.md
nodes.summary: Dev graph benchmark_result node (BENCH-002) recording gold-layer decision determinism and synthetic direction distribution across the regime feature grid, pinned via a committed golden artifact that a regression test asserts stays in sync.
nodes.languageNotes: Ontology type is benchmark_result (BENCH-002); measures replay_determinism, direction_distribution, regime_direction_map, confidence_stats, and uncertainty_stats.

nodes.name: Paper-Trading Runtime Benchmark.md
nodes.summary: Dev graph benchmark_result node (BENCH-003) recording paper-trading runtime determinism, idempotency, verdict distribution, and no-enrich-back invariant evidence, pinned via a committed golden artifact validated by a regression test.
nodes.languageNotes: Ontology type is benchmark_result (BENCH-003); measures replay_determinism, idempotency, verdict_distribution, no_enrich_back, and ledger_state_hash.

nodes.name: Regime Distribution Benchmark.md
nodes.summary: Dev graph benchmark_result node (BENCH-001, the first in the project) recording market-regime classifier determinism and synthetic feature-grid distribution covering all 11 signal regimes, with Shannon entropy and balance metrics pinned as a committable golden artifact.
nodes.languageNotes: Ontology type is benchmark_result (BENCH-001); measures distribution, coverage, entropy, classification_balance, unclassified_pct, rule_utilization, and regime_frequency.
